chunks: Qaf. I call to witness the glorious Qur'an.

key_terms.ق: A disjointed letter (Huruf al-Muqatta'at) starting Surah Qaf

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the oath in Surah Qaf verse 1?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the disjointed letter 'Qaf' is often interpreted as a reference to the divine attribute of creation or the soul, linking the oath to the origin of human existence. This verse establishes the Quran's supreme authority by having God swear by it, a rhetorical device that underscores its majesty and serves as a prelude to the Surah's themes of resurrection and the rejection of disbelievers. The emphasis on the 'Glorious' nature of the text invites believers to reflect on its role as a clear guide amidst the doubts of the polytheists of Mecca.
